description: This Java class, MongoSortKeyMappingFunction, defines a function that encodes an array of strings for use as a sort key in MongoDB. It escapes special characters, replaces slashes with dots, and joins the elements with dots.

classes.name: MongoSortKeyMappingFunction
classes.description: A utility class implementing a function to map string arrays to a single sorted key string suitable for MongoDB indexing.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the encoding and joining operations to the provided array of string values.

methods.name: mapSortKey
methods.description: Static method to quickly apply the transformation to input string arrays.
